title: Quantification of P. salmonis Intracellular Replication by Genome Equivalents
author: Pamela Aravena
materials: Isolate total genomic DNA (gDNA) from three independent cultures of infected SHK-1 cells per time, using the Blood & Tissue kit (Qiagen, USA) as recommended by the manufacturer.

qPCR assays are conducted using the TaqMan Gene expression assay kit (Invitrogen), and a TaqMan probe and primers (Table 1) targeting the single copy recF gene (GenBank Accession Number NZ_CP039032.1). Primers and probes used for conventional PCR and qPCR, used in this protocol.

PCR product is obtained after PCR amplification of recF from purified P. salmonis CGR02 genome using GoTaq Green Master Mix (Promega), containing 200 ng of bacterial DNA, 12.5 µL of GoTaq mix (Promega, Wisconsin, United States), 5.5 µL of nuclease free water and 1 µL of each primer recF-complete (10mM – Table 1). The PCR amplification was performed in T100 (Bio-Rad) Thermal cycling controller with the following protocol: 10 min at 95 °C, 30 cycles of 95 °C for 60 s, 60 °C for 30 s and 72 °C for 50 s, and a final extension at 72 °C for 10 min. The PCR product (884 bp) was purified using Wizard SV Gel and PCR Clean-Up System Kit (Promega).
Isolate total genomic DNA (gDNA) from three independent cultures of infected SHK-1 cells per time, using the Blood & Tissue kit (Qiagen, USA) as recommended by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Infect SHK-1 Cell Cultures
steps.instruction: Infect SHK-1 cell cultures at 80% confluence with stationary state bacterial cultures using a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 100:1 (bacteria:cell).

steps.title: Eliminate Extracellular Bacteria
steps.instruction: After 3 days of infection, remove extracellular bacteria from the cultures.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 40 mins with Leibovitz's L15 medium containing gentamicin (100 µg/mL) at 18 ºC.

steps.title: Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with PBS and incubate at 18 ºC with fresh Leibovitz's L15 medium supplemented with 5% FBS (without antibiotics).

steps.title: Harvest Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the infected SHK-1 cells after selecting appropriate infection times.

substeps.instruction: Wash the cell monolayers with cold PBS 1X.
Incubate with gentamicin (100 µg/mL) for 40 min to kill extracellular bacteria.
Wash the cells with cold PBS.
Treat cells with 0.25% trypsin-EDTA solution for 30 min at room temperature (RT).
Disrupt the monolayer by pipetting and collect cells in a 15 mL sterile tube.

steps.title: Prepare Genomic DNA (gDNA)
steps.instruction: Isolate and standardize the DNA from the collected cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 min.
Resuspend the pellets in 200 µL of PBS.
Evaluate DNA concentration and quality by measuring absorbance (260/280 nm) using a NanoQuant Spectrophotometer (Tecan Technologies).
Adjust gDNA samples to a concentration of 10 ng/µL.

steps.title: Generate qPCR Calibration Curve
steps.instruction: Create a standard curve using gel-purified PCR product of the recF gene.

substeps.instruction: Quantify product concentration by Qubit fluorometric quantitation.
Serially dilute the product to 10^6 and 10^0 copies of recF (using Equation 1 to convert ng of DNA to copy number).
Set up qPCR reactions in a total volume of 20 µL containing: 0.9 μM of each primer, 0.25 μM of probe, 10 µL of TaqMan Gene expression assays Master Mix, and 10 ng of recF PCR product as template.

Run the reactions in an AriaMx Pro thermal cycler (Agilent Technologies) using these conditions: initial incubation at 50 °C for 2 min, polymerase activation at 95 °C for 10 min, and 40 cycles of 95 °C for 15 s and 60 °C for 60 s.
Use the resulting fluorescent plots to create a calibration curve of Ct values vs. recF copy numbers.

steps.title: Quantify P. salmonis Genome Equivalents
steps.instruction: Determine the number of P. salmonis genomes in the experimental samples.

substeps.instruction: Set up qPCR reactions as described for the calibration curve, replacing the recF PCR product with the gDNA from the infections.
Interpolate the Ct values in the calibration curve to estimate the number of genomes.
Convert copy number to genome equivalents (GE) based on the presence of one copy of the recF gene in the P. salmonis genome.
